name: pdk-morph-kgc-etl
instr:
Our nightly order export has switched from one JSON document to UTF-8 JSON Lines files (.jsonl or .ndjson), and newer nights arrive gzip compressed (.jsonl.gz or .ndjson.gz). morph_kgc.materialize_set in /app can't use them as file sources, whether the mapping declares JSONPath or relies on the extension. Two nights of the export and our RML mapping are in /data/orders/.

Lines are separated by \n and each holds one JSON document. The mapping's iterator and references should apply to every document, with the same values and null handling as the existing JSON source. Every record in /data/orders/ should come through exactly as the producer sent it, including later corrections, without duplicate statements. A UTF-8 BOM at the start and blank lines are fine, and a file of only blank lines gives no statements. Invalid JSON must fail with an error that names its line number. Invalid UTF-8 and a damaged compressed file must fail too, never silently drop records.

Our queue consumer also passes the export text (a str) to materialize_set through python_source, mapped like our existing in-memory dictionary sources. That must give exactly the statements and errors the file gives.

Existing JSON, CSV, TSV and in-memory mappings must keep working, and materializing unchanged input twice gives the same statements. The existing repository tests should still pass. There's no network access; dependencies are installed.
